'''Greg Zinn''' is listed as '''[[Rules Advocate]]''' on public Players Committee organization charts, with forum handle '''Gergall'''<ref name="dt-25015">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/25015 Shes Virtually Back], DeckTech (Greg "Gergall" Zinn, 13 August 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/25015/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/25015/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009023403/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/25015/ Wayback Machine].</ref>.<ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref> He posted a [[Light]] [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|Rescue The Princess]] list on DeckTech (''Shes Virtually Back'').
